warnings.message: This payload is contract scaffolding from P0, not a computed result. The route exists so the frontend can be built in parallel; the engine behind it is not implemented yet.
The source DEM is SRTM at ~30 m (±6 m relative, ±16 m absolute LE90). Relief below about 5 m is interpolated, not measured, so sub-metre figures here describe the model, not the ground.
